senses.gloss: m. (ἄριστον) orig. morning meal, later principal meal, dinner, repast.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1:16">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵇ</cite> <he>אין הווה לכון א׳ כ׳</he> if ye are invited to a dinner, and the day is advanced, &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 3:8:8">Y. Snh. III, 21ᶜ</cite> top <he>גו א׳</he> during dinner. Ib. VI, 23ᶜ; a. fr.
